description: Which tests cover which supported configuration. Every model card, backend, device and precision the runtime supports is listed with the tiers that exercise it. Cheap tiers run on every change; expensive ones are reserved for specific events instead of running every combination on every PR. Rendered into docs/test-matrix.md by tools/test_matrix.py.

unit.when: every push and PR (Lint and CPU unit tests; Package)
unit.runs: pytest tests/unit, against fakes and tiny generated graphs; no real weights

real-cpu.when: weekly, on each published release, on demand, and on PRs touching the runtime (Real-model CPU validation)
real-cpu.runs: the pinned published model end to end on CPU (FLEURS fixtures, CER ceilings, determinism) plus the per-language FLEURS regression gate
real-cpu.command: OMNIASR_REAL_MODELS=1 python -m pytest tests/integration/test_real_models_cpu.py && python tools/fleurs_eval.py run --model {family} --gate

gpu.when: manually on a CUDA machine, before merging changes to GPU, precision, TensorRT or export code (no hosted GPU runner)
gpu.runs: ONNX CUDA precision agreement and TensorRT engines of the pinned model on the FLEURS fixtures and gate
gpu.command: python tools/evaluate_precisions.py --{family} <export> --device cuda --precision fp32 fp16 bf16 --dataset <eval.jsonl>; OMNIASR_REAL_MODELS=1 python -m pytest tests/integration/test_tensorrt_fleurs.py; python tools/fleurs_eval.py run --model ctc --backend tensorrt --precision mixed --gate

release.when: once per model, when it is exported or republished
release.runs: the precision-agreement report published in the model card (measured with CUDA; tools/publish_precisions.py); for LLMs, step-by-step fp32 logit parity with fairseq2 on CPU and CUDA (tools/validate_llm_fairseq2.py)
release.command: python tools/evaluate_precisions.py --{family} <export> --device cuda --precision fp32 fp16 bf16 --audio <clips> --report <report>; python tools/publish_precisions.py {repo} <export> --report <report> [--upload]; for LLMs also python tools/validate_llm_fairseq2.py compare <reference> --directory <export> --device cpu|cuda
